periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, slanted approximately 45-55 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid/teardrop shape where the vertical length is approximately 1.5 to 2 times the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, with the lowest point of the patch extending significantly below the geometric center of the eye.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation between the dark ear regions, roughly equivalent to the width of the white cranial vault between them.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and generally rounded tops, though the observer-left ear shows slight pixel-level flattening at the highest point.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible brownish-yellow staining across the ventral and thoracic fur regions, contrasting with the adjacent white pixels.
